highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands Linux, Tizen, GTK4, and .NET 10 support with targeted platform fixes.
highlights_body: This stable servicing release also adds native hardening, updates bundled dependencies, and rolls up the unreleased 3.119.3 preview.

breaking.title: Blazor _Imports is no longer a component
breaking.body: The generated `SkiaSharp.Views.Blazor._Imports` type no longer derives from `ComponentBase` or implements Blazor component interfaces. Do not use this implementation detail as a component base class.

bullets.detail: Adds SkiaSharp.Views.Gtk4 for applications using GirCore.Gtk-4.0 bindings.

bullets.lead: Desktop, Android, and native loading fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes GTK4 Cairo assertions, Android SKGLView rendering after MAUI tab switches, Linux ARM64 dependencies, and systems without DirectX 12.
Adds Linux Bionic native assets, Tizen x64 and arm64 builds, a net48 target for Windows validation, and .NET 10 SDK workload alignment.

bullets.lead: Native dependencies and binary safeguards refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and libexpat and carries additional native binary mitigations into the stable release.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and legacy target framework support
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android SKGLView rendering fix for MAUI tab switches

preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Preview 1 expanded Linux, Tizen, GTK4, and .NET 10 support with platform reliability fixes.
preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: The rolled-up 3.119.3 preview added AOT and Linux ARM64 fixes plus dependency refreshes.

harfbuzz_summary: Carries forward the synchronized HarfBuzzSharp servicing updates with the modernized platform support.
